title: Ensure 'Apply UAC restrictions to local accounts on network logons' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to Enabled: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Apply UAC restrictions to local accounts on network logons
reason: Local accounts are at high risk for credential theft when the same account and password is configured on multiple systems. Ensuring this policy is Enabled significantly reduces that risk.

title: Ensure 'Configure SMB v1 client driver' is set to 'Enabled: Disable driver (recommended)'
remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to Enabled: Disable driver (recommended): Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Configure SMB v1 client driver
reason: Since September 2016, Microsoft has strongly encouraged that SMBv1 be disabled and no longer used on modern networks, as it is a 30 year old design that is much more vulnerable to attacks then much newer designs such as SMBv2 and SMBv3.

title: Ensure 'Configure SMB v1 server' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to Disabled: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Configure SMB v1 server
reason: Since September 2016, Microsoft has strongly encouraged that SMBv1 be disabled and no longer used on modern networks, as it is a 30 year old design that is much more vulnerable to attacks then much newer designs such as SMBv2 and SMBv3.

title: Ensure 'Enable Certificate Padding' is set to 'Enabled'
powershell_check: try { $a = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography\Wintrust\Config' -Name 'EnableCertPaddingCheck' -ErrorAction Stop).EnableCertPaddingCheck; $b = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Microsoft\Cryptography\Wintrust\Config' -Name 'EnableCertPaddingCheck' -ErrorAction Stop).EnableCertPaddingCheck; if ($a -eq 1 -and $b -eq 1) { 1 } else { 0 } } catch { 0 }
remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to Enabled: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Enable Certificate Padding
reason: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the WinVerifyTrust function handles Windows Authenticode signature verification for portable executable (PE) files.

title: Ensure 'Enable Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection (SEHOP)' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to Enabled: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\Enable Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection (SEHOP)
reason: This feature is designed to block exploits that use the Structured Exception Handler (SEH) overwrite technique. This protection mechanism is provided at run-time.

title: Ensure 'NetBT NodeType configuration' is set to 'Enabled: P-node (recommended)'
remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to Enabled: P-node (recommended): Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\MS Security Guide\NetBT NodeType configuration
reason: In order to help mitigate the risk of NetBIOS Name Service (NBT-NS) poisoning attacks, setting the node type to P-node (point-to-point) will prevent the system from sending out NetBIOS broadcasts.
